Tailored Marvell Managed Networking Solutions Provider
Address: Room 316, 22nd Floor, Building 57, No.2 Hanghai East Road, Guancheng District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China, 450009
Mob: 86 13048800964 www.sagatelecom.com.cn Email: a.sagatelecom@gmail.com

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1chVSOnPIH_7Y4eE4knwUNgwotdY6Zguk?usp=drive_link
Must-Know
1. 10/100M, 10/100/1000M, 10G speeds are available
2. With DIP function for flexible use
3. 14-slot chassis mountable
4. Support watchdog function to restart the device when frozen
5. Full- positioned LEDs to indicate power and network status
6. 4KV surge protection; ESD: 8KV/contact, 15KV/air protection
7. Singlemode, multimode optical ports for difference distances
8. PoE models are NOT available
Ethernet Media Converter(Non-PoE, Unmanaged)
Model Specification Price Picture

1*100M SC/ST/FC Fiber+1*10/100M RJ45, with 2KM/20KM dual fiber module
Support LFP, watchdog, 4KV surge protection for Ethernet port and power supply interface

Remark: SFP fiber version is NOT available

1*10G Fiber+10/100/1000/2500M/10G RJ45
STC-110XGE Support LFP, watchdog, 4KV surge protection for Ethernet port and power supply interface $75.0

14-slot 2U Ethernet media converter rack, dual power supply(220V)

Remark: it could power above 3 models.
Remarks
1. Prices are valid for 15 days
2. Price term: EXW
3. Warranty period: One year
4. Lead time for less than 50pcs: 5~7 working days
5. Customization is available
